a:r.a:t: Operational path used by the soft-run Stock Phenotype Sheet
Read user CSV values from ext_gene or the chosen input-gene column.
Map current symbols first, then expanded synonyms, keeping only Dmel primary FBgn IDs.
Use direct GeneID -> AlleleID joins and construct-linked allele seeding through regulatory-region or encoded-product matches.
Collect construct and insertion IDs so a later stock match can happen through more than one component namespace.
Any FBal, FBtp, or FBti component can hit a stock via derived_stock_component.
Store relevant_component_ids = FBal union FBtp union FBti for the matched source-allele family.
Keep genotype_phenotype_data rows whose genotype_FBids overlap the relevant component set.
Resolve stock label, gene, reagent symbol, phenotype, qualifier, and reference metadata into the final sheet.
Inclusion depends on the chain FBgn -> source allele family -> relevant_component_ids -> genotype_FBids overlap.
Implementation anchors: fetch_fbgn_ids.py, stock_finding.py gene-component helpers, stock_splitting.py phenotype-sheet builder
